title: LingxiDiagBench: A Multi-Agent Framework for Benchmarking LLMs in Chinese Psychiatric Consultation and Diagnosis
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking psychiatric consultation and diagnostic accuracy. While it includes 'Ethical & Professional Conduct' as one of the criteria for evaluating the Doctor Agent within its multi-agent system, this is a clinical professional standard rather than a component evaluating religion, morals, or general ethics as specified in the prompt instructions.
